.xsj_foreignObject{
  width: 100%!important;
  height: 100%!important;
  text-align: initial;
  word-spacing: normal;
}
.xsj_foreignObject hr{
    margin: inherit;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject *{
  font-size: inherit;
}
.xsj_export_pdf .xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject *{
  font-size: 85%;
}

.xsj_export_pdf ins .mathjax .MathJax_SVG {
    border-bottom: 2px solid;
}

.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h1{
  font-size: 2em;
  margin-block-start: 0.67em;
  margin-block-end: 0.67em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h2{
  font-size: 1.5em;
  margin-block-start: 0.83em;
  margin-block-end: 0.83em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h3{
  font-size: 1.17em;
  margin-block-start: 1em;
  margin-block-end: 1em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h4{
  font-size: 1em;
  margin-block-start: 1.33em;
  margin-block-end: 1.33em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h5{
  font-size: .83em;
  margin-block-start: 1.67em;
  margin-block-end: 1.67em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.xsj_foreignObject.xsj_drawio_foreignObject h6{
  font-size: .67em;
  margin-block-start: 2.33em;
  margin-block-end: 2.33em;
  margin-inline-start: 0px;
  margin-inline-end: 0px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

/* xsj patch end */


/* title start */
h1.story_title {
    font-size: 1.8em;
    margin: 0.7em 0;
}
/* title end */

/* tag start */
.story_tags {
    margin: 0 0 1.2em;
}
.tag.label{
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    line-height: 1;
    margin: 0 0.5em 0.5em 0;
    background: #e2e2e2;
    border-color: #e2e2e2;
    background-image: none;
    padding: 0.6em 0.8em;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-radius: 0.2857rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-size: 12px;
}
/* tag end */

/* emoji */
img.emoji {
    width: 1em;
    line-height: 1em;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}
/* emoji */

/* align grammar start*/

.story_align_left, .story_align_left .story_image_container {
    text-align: left;
}
.story_align_right, .story_align_right .story_image_container {
    text-align: right;
}
.story_align_center, .story_align_center .story_image_container {
    text-align: center;
}
.story_align_justify, .story_align_justify .story_image_container {
    text-align: justify;
}

/* align grammar end*/

/*mindmap start*/
.mindmap_container {
  text-align: center;
}

.xsj_mindmap_caption{
   border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
  display: inline-block;
  color: #999;
  padding: 10px;
}
/*mindmap end*/



/* table start*/

table {
  max-width: 100%;
  background-color: transparent;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-spacing: 0;
  word-break: break-word;
  border: 1px solid #d9d9da;
}
.table {
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: auto;
}

.table th,
.table td {
  padding: 8px;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
  border-top: 1px solid #d9d9da;
}

.table th {
  font-weight: bold;
}

.table thead th {
  vertical-align: bottom;
}

.table tbody + tbody {
  border-top: 2px solid #d9d9da;
}

.table .table {
  background-color: #ffffff;
}


.table-striped tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > td,
.table-striped tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) > th {
  background-color: #f9f9f9;
}

.table-celled.table tr td,.table-celled.table tr th {
    border-left: 1px solid #d9d9da;
}

/* table end*/

/*code start*/

code {
    background-color: #F0F0F0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
    margin: 0 .225em;
    color: #880000;
}
body code{
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: .9em;
}

.hljs, .hljs * {
  overflow: visible !important;
} 

body .xiaoshujiang_code {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: .9em;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code ol{
    margin-top: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
}

.xiaoshujiang_pre {
    line-height: initial !important;
    word-wrap: break-word;
    word-break: break-all;
    tab-size: 4;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    font-family: monospace;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_container pre{
    margin: 0px;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_container.xiaoshujiang_code_chunk{
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #A3C293 inset,0 0 0 0 transparent;
    margin: 1em 0;
    padding: 1em;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_container.xiaoshujiang_code_chunk_hide_code{
    box-shadow: initial;
    padding: initial;
    padding-bottom: 2em;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_container .out_put{
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #A3C293 inset,0 0 0 0 transparent;
    margin: 1em 0;
    background-color: #FCFFF5;
    color: #2C662D;
    padding: 1em;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_container .out_put_error{
    background-color: #FFF6F6;
    color: #9F3A38;
    margin: 1em 0;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #E0B4B4 inset,0 0 0 0 transparent;
    padding: 1em;
}

/*code end*/

/* code line nums start*/

code.hljs.code_linenums, .xiaoshujiang_code.hljs.code_linenums{
    position: relative;
}
.ol_linenums{
    padding: 0px;
    margin-left: 2em;
    border-left: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
}
.li_linenum{
    position:relative;
    margin-left: 0.5em;
    list-style: none;
    counter-increment: lines 1;
}
.li_linenum.li_list_style{
    list-style: inherit;
    margin-left: 5px;
}
.li_linenum:before, .li_linenum_before_span{
    content: counter(lines, decimal);
  position: absolute;
  left: -3em;
  text-align: center;
  width: 2.5em;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.li_linenum_before_span_hide{
    display: none;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code .code_line_break_hack{
    margin:0;
    border:0;
    border-top:0;
    border-bottom:0;
}
.component_attachment, .code_line_break_hack{
  display: none;
  visibility: collapse!important;
  height: 0!important;
}

/* code line nums end*/

/* block code start */
.xiaoshujiang_code_container {
    margin: 1em 0px 2em;
    position: relative;
}


.xiaoshujiang_code_title_container{
    font-size: 50%;
}
.xiaoshujiang_code_title_container>.xiaoshujiang_code_infos{
    float: right;
}
/* block code end */


/*mark start*/

.mark{
  border: 0;
  background-color: rgba(221, 243, 231, 0.4);
  color: #105012;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}

.mark_color_000000{
  color: transparent!important;
  background: initial!important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #3a4c42;
  transition: color .6s;
}

.mark_color_000000:hover{
  color: black!important;
}

.li_linenum.line_mark:before, .line_mark .li_linenum_before_span {
    background: rgba(65, 174, 60, 0.6);
}
.line_mark{
  background: rgba(65, 174, 60, 0.3);
}



.li_linenum.line_mark_warn:before, .line_mark_warn .li_linenum_before_span {
    background: rgba(252, 121, 48, .6);
}
.line_mark_warn{
  background: rgba(252, 121, 48, .3);
}

.li_linenum.line_mark_info:before, .line_mark_info .li_linenum_before_span {
    background: rgba(97, 154, 195, .6);
}
.line_mark_info{
  background: rgba(97, 154, 195, .3);
}

.li_linenum.line_mark_error:before, .line_mark_error .li_linenum_before_span {
    background: rgba(210, 118, 118, 0.6);
}
.line_mark_error{
  background: rgba(210, 174, 174, 0.3);
}

.line_mark_del{
  text-decoration: line-through;
  text-decoration: 2px line-through;
}
.line_mark_ins{
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration: 2px underline;
}

code .mark, .xiaoshujiang_code .mark{
    border-radius: 0px;
    font-size: initial;
    padding: initial;
}
/*mark end*/


.xsj_code_strong{
  -webkit-text-emphasis: triangle;
  -webkit-text-emphasis-position: under;
}

/* attachment start */
a.attachment{
    background: #ecf0f3;
    border: 1px solid #bec6cb;
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.6em;
    margin: 0.5em 0.5em;
    min-width: 250px;
}
a.attachment i.fa{
    font-size: 3em;
  float: left;
  margin-right: 0.2em;
}
a.attachment .filename{
    vertical-align: top;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: bold;
}
a.attachment .filesize{
  display: -webkit-box;
  display: -moz-box;
  display: -ms-flexbox;
  display: -webkit-flex;
  display: flex;
  opacity: .6;
  font-size: 80%;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* attachment end */


/*code chunk video, slideshare start*/
.video_container{
    width: 100%;
    display: table;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 56.25%!important;
}

.video_container iframe{
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.slideshare_container .inner{
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
}

.slideshare_container .inner iframe{
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
}

/*code chunk video, slideshare start*/



/*mermaid start*/

.mermaid {
    text-align: center;
}

.mermaid_svg{
    font-family: monospace;
    text-align: initial;
}
.mermaid_svg foreignObject{
  overflow: visible;
}
.mermaid_svg foreignObject i.fa{
  min-width: 16px;
}
.mermaid_svg .svg-inline--fa,.mermaid_svg .svg-inline--fa path {
    fill: initial!important;
    stroke: initial!important;
}

.mermaid_svg .grid path {
  stroke: transparent;
}
/*mermaid stop*/


/* patch evernote start*/
.toc ul {
    list-style-type: none;
}
/* patch evernote end*/


/* image start*/
img {
    height: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    vertical-align: middle;
    border: 0;
}

.story_image_container{
    text-align: center;
}
.story_image_container>.story_image{
    display: inline-block;
    position: relative;
    max-width: 100%;
}
.story_image_caption, .xsj_remote_html_caption {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
    display: inline-block;
    color: #999;
    padding: 10px;
}
.story_image_blank_caption, .xsj_remote_html_blank_caption{
    display: none;
}
.story_image>img{
    border-radius: 0.3125em;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(34,36,38,.12),0 2px 10px 0 rgba(34,36,38,.08);
}

.story_inline_image{
  display: inline-block;
}
.story_inline_image>img{
    vertical-align: bottom;
}
/* image end*/

.story_remote_resource_block{
    text-align: center;
}

/* task list start */
.task-list-item{
    list-style: none;
}
.task-list-item.li_list_style{
    list-style:inherit;
}
.task-list-item > p {
  margin: 0;
}

/* task list end */

/* other start */
em.cjk_emphasis{
    font-style: normal;
    font-family: Georgia,"Times New Roman",Times,"楷体","AR PL UKai CN", "NSimSun","Songti SC","SimSun",serif!important;
}

.flow-chart, .sequence-diagram{
    text-align: center;
}
.plot, .plot-image{
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 200px;
    min-width: 200px;
}

ins .mathjax .MathJax_SVG {
    border-bottom: 1px solid;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.mathjax-container{
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 auto;
}
div.mathjax{
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.mathjax-container .math_equation_table{
  border: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.mathjax-container .math_equation_table td{
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.xsj_export_pdf .fa-border {
  border: none;
  border-radius: initial;
  padding: initial;
  margin: 0 .25em;
  outline-offset: .2em;
  outline: 1px solid #eee;
}
.preview.html_preview{
  max-width: 100%;
}

.xsj_export_pdf.preview.html_preview{
  max-width: initial;
  border: initial;
  margin: initial;
  padding: initial;
  border-radius: initial;
  box-shadow: initial;
}
/* other end */




/* blockquote start*/
/** only icon **/
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote{
    position: relative;
}
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote.markdown_blockquote_icon{
    margin-left: 10px;
}
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote>.xsj_paragraph:first-child>i:first-child{
    background-color: #dedede;
    border-radius: 100%;
    left: -18px;
    line-height: 30px;
    position: absolute;
    height: 30px;
    width: 30px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px!important;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0px;

}

.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote>.xsj_paragraph:first-child>.svg-image:first-child,
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote>.xsj_paragraph:first-child>svg.svg-inline--fa:first-child {
    background-color: #dedede;
    border-radius: 100%;
    left: -15px;
    line-height: 30px;
    position: absolute;
    height: 20px;
    width: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0px 5px #dedede;
    font-size: 16px!important;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0px;
    outline: 0;
    margin: 0;
}
/** only icon **/
/** heading **/
.html_preview > .markdown_blockquote.markdown_blockquote_heading {
    margin-top: 40px;
    page-break-inside: auto;
}
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote_heading>.xsj_heading:first-child {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.4em;
    background-color: #dedede;
    padding: 0 15px;
    margin: -20px;
    position: relative;
}
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote_heading>.xsj_heading:first-child .xsj_heading_content>i:first-child {
    background-color: #dedede;
    border-radius: 100%;
    left: -16px;
    top: .25em;
    line-height: 30px;
    position: absolute;
    height: 30px;
    width: 30px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0px;
}

.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote_heading>.xsj_heading:first-child .xsj_heading_content>.svg-image:first-child,
.html_preview>.markdown_blockquote_heading>.xsj_heading:first-child .xsj_heading_content>svg.svg-inline--fa:first-child {
    background-color: #dedede;
    border-radius: 100%;
    left: -15px;
    top: .25em;
    line-height: 30px;
    position: absolute;
    height: 20px;
    width: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0px 5px #dedede;
    font-size: 16px!important;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0px;
    outline: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

/** heading **/
/* blockquote end*/


@media print{
  body{
    word-wrap: break-word;
    word-break: break-word;
    background: initial!important;
    font-kerning: normal;
    text-rendering: geometricPrecision;
  }
  .preview.html_preview{
    max-width: initial;
    border: initial;
    margin: initial;
    padding: initial;
    border-radius: initial;
    box-shadow: initial;
  }
  .xiaoshujiang_element.xsj_anchor{
    position: absolute;
  }
  tr { page-break-inside: avoid; }
  .story_image_container{
     page-break-inside: avoid;
  }
  blockquote{
    page-break-inside: avoid;
  }

  .xsj_underline{
      page-break-after: always;
      visibility: hidden;
  }
}

/*

Original highlight.js style (c) Ivan Sagalaev &lt;maniac@softwaremaniacs.org>

*/

.hljs {
  display: block;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 0.5em;
  background: #F0F0F0;
}


/* Base color: saturation 0; */

.hljs,
.hljs-subst {
  color: #444;
}

.hljs-comment {
  color: #888888;
}

.hljs-keyword,
.hljs-attribute,
.hljs-selector-tag,
.hljs-meta .hljs-keyword,
.hljs-doctag,
.hljs-name {
  font-weight: bold;
}


/* User color: hue: 0 */

.hljs-type,
.hljs-string,
.hljs-number,
.hljs-selector-id,
.hljs-selector-class,
.hljs-quote,
.hljs-template-tag,
.hljs-deletion {
  color: #880000;
}

.hljs-title,
.hljs-section {
  color: #880000;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.hljs-regexp,
.hljs-symbol,
.hljs-variable,
.hljs-template-variable,
.hljs-link,
.hljs-selector-attr,
.hljs-selector-pseudo {
  color: #BC6060;
}


/* Language color: hue: 90; */

.hljs-literal {
  color: #78A960;
}

.hljs-built_in,
.hljs-bullet,
.hljs-code,
.hljs-addition {
  color: #397300;
}


/* Meta color: hue: 200 */

.hljs-meta {
  color: #1f7199;
}

.hljs-meta .hljs--string {
  color: #4d99bf;
}


/* Misc effects */

.hljs-emphasis {
  font-style: italic;
}

.hljs-strong {
  font-weight: bold;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'SmileySans';
  src: url('https://chinese-fonts-cdn.deno.dev/packages/dyh/dist/smileysans-oblique/result.css') format('woff2');
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: oblique;
  font-display: swap;
}

.smiley-text {
  font-family: 'SmileySans', "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif !important;
  font-style: oblique;        /* 保持得意黑的斜体风格 */
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;      /* 可选：让文字更舒服 */
}




/**xsjCSSMeta
previewTheme: default
xsjCSSMeta**/
/* 引用得意黑字体库 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'SmileySans';
  src: url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/atelier-anchor/smiley-sans@main/dist/SmileySans-Oblique.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-display: swap;
}


/* 数学块通用容器 */
.math-container {
    margin: 1.5em 0;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    /* 默认字体，可根据需要调整 */
    font-family: 'Kaiti', 'SmileySans', 'SimSun', sans-serif;
}

/* 命题/定义 头部 */
.math-header {
    background-color: var(--head-bg, #4caf50); /* 默认为绿色 */
    color: white;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-family: var(--head-font, 'SmileySans'); /* 头部默认得意黑 */
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

/* 命题/定义 内容区 */
.math-content {
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
    border: 1px solid var(--head-bg, #4caf50);
    border-top: none;
    padding: 15px;
    font-family: var(--content-font, 'Kaiti'); /* 内容默认文楷 */
    line-height: 1.7;
}

/* 证明块 (虚线框样式) */
.proof-block {
    margin: 1.5em 0;
    padding: 15px;
    border: 2px dashed #ed8d39; /* 默认橙色虚线 */
    border-radius: 8px;
    position: relative;
    font-family: var(--proof-font, 'SimSun');
}

.proof-title {
    color: #ed8d39;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    display: block;
    text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}

.qed-sign {
    float: right;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ed8d39;
    margin-top: 10px;
}
.proof-block::after {
    content: "";
    display: table;
    clear: both;
}




h1 {
    font-family: "SmileySans", "得意黑", Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 2.8em;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: center;
    
    /* 初始颜色 */
    color: #ffd700;
    
    /* 动画：控制颜色变浅 + 光晕变糊 */
    animation: goldBreath 4.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    
    border-bottom: 3px solid #ffcc00;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    margin: 40px 0 35px 0;
}

@keyframes goldBreath {
    from {
        /* 颜色较深，光晕较紧凑 */
        color: #ffb300; 
        text-shadow: 
            0 0 5px #ffd700,
            0 0 10px rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.5);
    }
    to {
        /* 颜色变浅（接近白色），光晕变大变糊 */
        color: #fff9c4; 
        text-shadow: 
            0 0 12px #ffffff,
            0 0 25px #ffcc00,
            0 0 45px rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.8);
    }
}
    &lt;/style>

    &lt;script>
        window.MathJax = {
            tex: {
                inlineMath: [['$', '$'], ['\\(', '\\)']], // 行内公式
                displayMath: [['$$', '$$'], ['\\[', '\\]']], // 独行公式
                processEscapes: true
            }
        };
    &lt;/script>
    &lt;script id="MathJax-script" async src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-chtml.js">&lt;/script>
&lt;/head>
&lt;body>
    &lt;div class="preview" id="wmd-preview">
        
	&lt;div class="preview html_preview xsj_export_html">&lt;div class="story_cover" style="display:none;">
&lt;img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," name="undefined" data-src="xiaoshujiangaly1.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/小书匠/神秘多元微分学/ba0d41cea1888c9951dd67b9c4f48df5.jpg" loading="lazy">
&lt;h1 class="story_title">神秘多元微分学&lt;/h1>&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;/p>&lt;div class="toc normal_toc">&lt;ul>&lt;li>&lt;ul>&lt;li>&lt;a href="#1_1" data-hash="c4ca4238a0b923820dcc509a6f75849b">1&lt;/a>&lt;/li>&lt;li>&lt;a href="#2_2" data-hash="c81e728d9d4c2f636f067f89cc14862c">2&lt;/a>&lt;/li>&lt;/ul>&lt;/li>&lt;/ul>&lt;br>
&lt;span class="mark mark_color mark_color_EE3F4D" style="color:#EE3F4D;background-color:rgba(238, 63, 77, 0.1)">作者的话&lt;/span>：&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">markdowm好麻烦！&lt;/strong>&lt;br>
从零开始的异世界多元微分学生活！&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;h2 class="xsj_heading_hash xsj_heading xsj_heading_h2" id="1_1">&lt;div class="xiaoshujiang_element xsj_anchor">
  &lt;a name="1_1" class="blank_anchor_name">&lt;/a>&lt;a id="1_1" class="blank_anchor_id">&lt;/a>&lt;a name="1" class="blank_anchor_name">&lt;/a>&lt;a id="1" class="blank_anchor_id">&lt;/a>

&lt;span class="xsj_heading_content">1&lt;/span>&lt;/h2>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">我们这里从最简单的动机开始考虑多元微积分的事情&lt;br>
我们已经知道一元微积分的定义了：&lt;br>
&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-1-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c7bbbc8dfca6956f60f795dfc11395fc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-1">\frac{df}{dx} = \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{f(x_0 + t) - f(x_0)}{t}&lt;/script>&lt;br>
这里&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-2-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5e8b7e67b1cd5a235bdc1fbe6e31311f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-2">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span>是函数名,&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-3-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="91cb7973eb31bfc3b30a5bed6ffbc3e4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-3">x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>自变量名,&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-4-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2fc2d38c12c3fca2b623b88e5529f413.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-4">t&lt;/script>&lt;/span>是参数名。&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">很自然的，我们生活中遇到的一个因变量经常与很多其他多个自变量相关，举例说就有山峰的表面积、产品的利润、曲面的梯度等等.&lt;br>
在一元函数中我们研究函数的方式是考虑&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-5-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5e8b7e67b1cd5a235bdc1fbe6e31311f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-5">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span>在极小范围内的变动，然后这个变动刚好可以用线性的东西来近似，把这个思想同样引入多元函数要怎么操作呢？&lt;br>
举个例子好了，设&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-6-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="d84037fa737d84a7494bac4682fdb73d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-6">f(x,y) = x + y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，然后&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-7-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="91cb7973eb31bfc3b30a5bed6ffbc3e4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-7">x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>,&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-8-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="47917c9aaacf04a9577a0c35c5f27a5e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-8">y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>同时开始变动：&lt;br>
&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-9-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="3dd4a5617c6c9dccda1d9434618dde6c.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-9">f(x+\Delta x, y+\Delta y) = f(x,y) + \Delta f(x,y) = x + \Delta x + y + \Delta y&lt;/script>&lt;br>
容易得到&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-10-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="00fb84df645749ab367b6f3bf98becd8.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-10">\Delta f(x,y) = \Delta x  + \Delta y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>&lt;br>
这非常符合预期！&lt;br>
进一步升级，设&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-11-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8e22dfbb0ff428870e05bc5752cc8714.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-11">f(x, y) = x^2 + y^2&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，然后重复操作得到：&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-12-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="79075b6f4cb67fb1a5fa7726c91dcdd1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-12">\Delta f(x,y) = 2\Delta x + 2\Delta y + \Delta x^2 + \Delta y^2&lt;/script>&lt;br>
这里我们对比一下一元函数微分的定义：&lt;span id="point01.1">&lt;/span>   &lt;!-- 定义锚点1 -->&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #90EE90; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>01.1 一元函数的微分&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-13-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-13">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-14-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-14">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的一个邻域 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-15-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="9cd60f316645f7dde2f174476ffae411.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-15">N(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上有定义, 若存在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-16-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="656d312edaa1d5afe9682d0c90ce87b4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-16">\lambda \in \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 使得 &lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-17-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="df717cc1b62cfee44be58f7b9e35b363.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-17">\Delta f(x_0) = \lambda \Delta x + o(\Delta x), \Delta x \to 0.&lt;/script> 则称函数在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-18-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-18">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">可微&lt;/strong> (differentiable). 关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-19-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="ce502fec2ad1d91badd9de63b1ad30eb.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-19">\Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的线性函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-20-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="3d89fb5e998cdd2e3f8f815864bcdf5b.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-20">\lambda \Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 称为函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-21-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-21">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-22-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-22">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处的&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">微分&lt;/strong> (differential), 记作 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-23-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="36a8414b1d764e7c4fdfefb062e0d784.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-23">df(x_0) = \lambda \Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-24-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="69a9d78492db7777df207851da4c5594.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-24">\lambda = f'(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 特别地, 对于正比例函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-25-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="44d937645a7da55232e8da71d049ef1f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-25">g(x) = x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 由于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-26-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="d7306beb3dcbc8f33c4ddddb98b8f0cb.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-26">g'(x) = 1&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 故 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-27-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="f9cb9b3a9266cedc192d3a374e705147.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-27">dg(x) = dx = \Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 于是有 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-28-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="7d079d46141b13ccf2b6c4fcc4729e0a.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-28">df(x_0) = f'(x_0)dx&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">可见我们希望&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-29-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="f4e7bdca669e7f82ade20700631fd9fe.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-29">\Delta f(x,y)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>的主要部分应当最好也是&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-30-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="3e2e75522c1d206fc83e330b99e7bba4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-30">\Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>、&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-31-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="7cec4d55a851385c076b513ad0d0df6e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-31">\Delta y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>与常数线性组合的模样；而剩余的那么“一点点”则我们猜想用一种“变动越小它也越小”的东西来标记它，那么“距离”&lt;sup class="footnote-ref">&lt;a href="#fn1" id="fnref1">[1]&lt;/a>&lt;/sup>可能很不错：&lt;br>
这里我们直接定义全增量为&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-32-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c17bdaae28f2222adc9000ba0deb4cbf.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-32">h = (h_1, h_2, \dots, h_n)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，那么自然距离就是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-33-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="78f80c7229f0f5a432d284a4c66febcf.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-33">\|h\|&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
下面直接给出我们理想中的“无穷小增量公式”：&lt;/p>
&lt;center>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-34-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="fc397f8718f870d2f72d989c929c7365.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-34">f(x_0 + h) - f(x_0) = \lambda h + o(\|h\|)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>,&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-35-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="d96d0c6f73573ea0641c93b4f7eb9614.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-35">\|h\| \to 0&lt;/script>&lt;/span>&lt;/p>&lt;/center>&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">很自然地，引出多元函数的相应定义：&lt;span id="point1.1">&lt;/span>&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>1.1 多元函数的全微分&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-36-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="6c47e00e2763a02be3c9ebc9db956172.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-36">f : D \to \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-37-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-37">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-38-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5314527605086d2c654c649fbd7ed01f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-38">\mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上的一个开集. 给定 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-39-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8599c17c4fc196fc49421c15a932c441.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-39">x_0 \in D&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 若存在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-40-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="b887ac93de2c6a4fd3394b1a7caab700.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-40">\lambda = (\lambda_1, \lambda_2, \cdots, \lambda_n)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 使得 &lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-41-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="cf2e4ece86ed443f92a2d7c864c87576.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-41">f(x_0 + h) - f(x_0) = \lambda h + o(\|h\|), \|h\| \to 0,&lt;/script>其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-42-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="b638c4b19f6d3b4bda40535215e44ed7.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-42">h = (h_1, h_2, \cdots, h_n)^T&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是全增量, 则称函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-43-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-43">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-44-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-44">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">可微&lt;/strong> (differentiable). 并称关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-45-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="75d4047e36b0759ebc2c31ffaa7ab1a6.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-45">h&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的线性映射 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-46-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="bd317c065105b604dbee8ba366290c8c.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-46">\lambda h&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 为 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-47-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-47">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-48-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-48">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处的&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">全微分&lt;/strong> (total differential), 简称微分. 记作 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-49-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="ff03b038f1ae0af336171b78a0e16865.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-49">df(x_0) = \lambda h&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 若 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-50-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-50">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-51-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-51">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上的每一点都可微, 则称 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-52-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-52">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-53-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-53">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上的一个可微函数 (differentiable function).&lt;br>
&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;em>为什么用开集呢，是因为内点定义就是移动足够小的一段距离，它还在定义域内&lt;/em>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">你可能注意到了这里用的是全微分而不是微分，这是因为还有&lt;ins>偏微分&lt;/ins>这种东西：&lt;br>
试想&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-54-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5657acb5847e4fa178eb4390f091bcb1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-54">x = (x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>中仅有&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-55-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="e169aa2d2b71835f2203bc943bda9a9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-55">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>移动，那么其他的变量和常量没有区别，也就相当于形形色色的参数，那我们再对这种函数求微分，和一元函数微积分没有什么区别，得到的东西就叫偏微分：&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>1.2  多元函数的偏微分&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-56-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="6c47e00e2763a02be3c9ebc9db956172.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-56">f: D \to \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-57-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="4b63099bf474bc26cc3d1ed1f0173573.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-57">D \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 为开集，&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-58-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="b2bfdbc2e5776a90e1d45843d5e4fb4b.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-58">x_0 = (x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n) \in D&lt;/script>&lt;/span>。若将除 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-59-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="480a23f8a2684f963b8b978f06656a49.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-59">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 外的其余自变量固定，视 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-60-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-60">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 为关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-61-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="480a23f8a2684f963b8b978f06656a49.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-61">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的一元函数，且存在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-62-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="ff872bbce8d37b5c16a8242169131749.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-62">\lambda_i \in \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 使得&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-63-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="020c3f1b2616bfe67a46625e32189f6c.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-63">\Delta_{x_i} f(x_0) = f(x_1, \cdots, x_i + \Delta x_i, \cdots, x_n) - f(x_0) = \lambda_i \Delta x_i + o(\Delta x_i), \Delta x_i \to 0&lt;/script>则称函数在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-64-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-64">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-65-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="480a23f8a2684f963b8b978f06656a49.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-65">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> &lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">偏可微&lt;/strong> (partially differentiable)。关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-66-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="54951b14f63053187b4014d86903441e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-66">\Delta x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的线性函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-67-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2e2612409626f99be8552c0c24d87547.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-67">\lambda_i \Delta x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 称为函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-68-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-68">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-69-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-69">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处关于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-70-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="480a23f8a2684f963b8b978f06656a49.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-70">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">偏微分&lt;/strong> (partial differential)，记作&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-71-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="9ed72387520278ba534f0caa4d5500a1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-71">d_{x_i} f(x_0) = \lambda_i \Delta x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-72-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="7eaf54ab09f1abf86c4d3b33b866ade8.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-72">\lambda_i = f'_{x_i}(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>（即偏导数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-73-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="0060d18eb6bd7bc9a27f297eb27770fc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-73">\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_i}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>）。特别地，对于坐标投影函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-74-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="725c205c8ebecc228126dca75a4f8e46.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-74">g(x) = x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，由于 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-75-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="25b3a42b5485b228c57b90562bbe98cc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-75">g'_{x_i}(x) = 1&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，故&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-76-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="db190ed6bfcb5089724823257b6dc58a.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-76">d g(x) = d x_i = \Delta x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>于是有&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-77-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="3b003fe21e0caacb93fb63d9331359db.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-77">d_{x_i} f(x_0) = \frac{\partial f(x_0)}{\partial x_i} dx_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>&lt;br>
&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">等等，这里的偏导数又是什么东西，哦，原来在多元函数的世界里面连导数都有一点点小变化，让我们看看这里的&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-78-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="927ecefe9cfd6e9873ad7fdfd5821507.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-78">\lambda&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 究竟是什么——&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">在一元函数的世界里面，可导和可微是一个概念，在&lt;a href="#point01.1" class="xsj_link xsj_manu_link">上文&lt;/a>中我们知道一元函数微分的线性主要部分&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-79-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="fd9408042b0e584b74d5508d7c05945e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-79">\lambda \Delta x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>中的&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-80-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="927ecefe9cfd6e9873ad7fdfd5821507.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-80">\lambda&lt;/script>&lt;/span>就是函数的导数，那么同理也会猜想多元函数的微分的主要部分中的线性系数也是一种导数，即为极小范围内变化时因变量相对自变量接近线性的变化率.可以说这个猜测完全是正确的，但具体怎么衡量这种线性的变化率呢？&lt;br>
最简单的想法当然是拟照偏微分的思想搞一个偏导数，也就是只有一个变量动的情况：&lt;span id="point1.3">&lt;/span>&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>1.3 多元函数的方向导数与偏导数&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-81-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="6c47e00e2763a02be3c9ebc9db956172.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-81">f : D \to \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-82-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-82">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-83-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5314527605086d2c654c649fbd7ed01f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-83">\mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上的一个开集. 给定一个方向向量 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-84-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="637918482a41bf1ad13ed90fa01b2330.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-84">u&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 和一点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-85-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-85">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 若存在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-86-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="098bdd32113c47d4419504e4d04dae72.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-86">l \in \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 使得 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-87-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="87b76b83ca0a4230cf7fd5395beac4a3.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-87">\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{f(x_0 + tu) - f(x_0)}{t} = l&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 则称 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-88-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAQAAAAPCAYAAADDNm69AAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAHFJREFUKFONz7EJwgAQQNEXECFWQsDOCewk2cI+IVtkEnELKyETWKbKIBaiI4QDr9HGKx/8467wNcXfUGGNXSQrXHDCmDu2eKFJaHDDIeGMPfqAEndMGAKyrzEHZH/EOyD7J64BbbQI6HLp5nPg4+e5BRgNEGyas23BAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC" name="69ada1423f3315dec7836dc08b862414.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-88">l&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 为 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-89-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-89">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-90-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-90">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 沿着 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-91-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="637918482a41bf1ad13ed90fa01b2330.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-91">u&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">方向导数&lt;/strong> (directional derivative), 记作 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-92-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="6f701e264e7bc385f86fd40b35c5b1f5.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-92">\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}(x_0) := \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{f(x_0 + tu) - f(x_0)}{t}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
我们称 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-93-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-93">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-94-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-94">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处沿第 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-95-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAUAAAAOCAYAAADnqNYmAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAI9JREFUKFONz7EKQQEUBuDvKlIMyht4ABNlsdstRpPdYGGRTPIU6uYBLGajTN7AA5hRik7dW3cwOHWW75xO/0n8qOQfrOJZ3OxggWURu5hjnGM5u/3GJ7COEdrY4RI4wBBNnLEJnOCIG2bYBkb3sc9O3ANqWGfDAx6BDVyxQi+yBsYXU7RwQprnrKCEV+T8ApVoFqLiZZbBAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC" name="2593148b3e609c8d7e64606bc1153b4b.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-95">i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 个单位坐标向量 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-96-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="f2991f92c6be2145117c1dcc22945bed.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-96">e_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的方向导数为 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-97-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-97">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-98-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-98">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处的第 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-99-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAUAAAAOCAYAAADnqNYmAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAI9JREFUKFONz7EKQQEUBuDvKlIMyht4ABNlsdstRpPdYGGRTPIU6uYBLGajTN7AA5hRik7dW3cwOHWW75xO/0n8qOQfrOJZ3OxggWURu5hjnGM5u/3GJ7COEdrY4RI4wBBNnLEJnOCIG2bYBkb3sc9O3ANqWGfDAx6BDVyxQi+yBsYXU7RwQprnrKCEV+T8ApVoFqLiZZbBAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC" name="2593148b3e609c8d7e64606bc1153b4b.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-99">i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 个&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">偏导数&lt;/strong> (partial derivative),即&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-100-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="1a9cdd69e6494152d1ee2e0d372fbddc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-100">\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{f(x_1, \cdots, x_i + t, \cdots, x_n) - f(x_1, \cdots, x_i, \cdots, x_n)}{t}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，记作 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-101-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="676043fccb8c930020c3955d6eaeec31.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-101">\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_i}(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 或 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-102-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="63e0dd3cc5ec2c69b9e8997cc82dfc19.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-102">f'_{x_i}(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 或 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-103-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c729ef273e61b1ace817136d51e9f1a0.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-103">D_{x_i} f(x_0)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
&lt;/p>&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">如果用&lt;a href="https://github.com/iron-water/Great-notes/blob/main/%E6%95%B0%E5%AD%A6/%E6%95%B0%E5%AD%A6%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90/%E8%AF%BE%E6%9C%AC%E8%B5%84%E6%BA%90/%E6%95%B0%E5%AD%A6%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90II_%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E5%88%B02023%E5%B9%B42%E6%9C%8824%E6%97%A5%5B1%5D.pdf" class="xsj_link xsj_manu_link">这里&lt;/a>的图就非常好理解了&lt;br>
&lt;span class="story_inline_image">&lt;img src="data:image/png;base64," data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-cache="true" alt="enter description here" title="enter description here" name="images/d3b0e3f1c8c68932e8e6bb24cf6d4a79.png" data-src="xiaoshujiangaly1.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/%E5%B0%8F%E4%B9%A6%E5%8C%A0/%E7%A5%9E%E7%A7%98%E5%A4%9A%E5%85%83%E5%BE%AE%E5%88%86%E5%AD%A6/d3b0e3f1c8c68932e8e6bb24cf6d4a79.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">那请问有没有全导数呢？&lt;br>
有的，直接回到全微分的&lt;a href="#point1.1" class="xsj_link xsj_manu_link">定义&lt;/a>中去，我们发现这里的&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-104-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="927ecefe9cfd6e9873ad7fdfd5821507.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-104">\lambda&lt;/script>&lt;/span>似乎暗藏玄机：&lt;br>
直接运用定义，分别令&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-105-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="550e9e85348d6030b01f776f50ba6eb8.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-105">h_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span>外的所有分量取0，然后带回原式：&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">这时&lt;br>
&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-106-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="4fc37f00cd03c35ac42100b6f4e55845.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-106">f(x_1, \cdots, x_i + h_i, \cdots, x_n) - f(x_1, \cdots, x_i, \cdots, x_n) = \lambda_i h_i + o(|h_i|).&lt;/script>&lt;br>
于是&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-107-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2eabdf9c4b93f35e94490b52df5d88ee.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-107">\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_i} = \lim_{h_i \to 0} \frac{f(x_1, \cdots, x_i + h_i, \cdots, x_n) - f(x_1, \cdots, x_i, \cdots, x_n)}{h_i} = \lambda_i, \quad i = 1, 2, \cdots, n.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
重复操作强行求出&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-108-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="927ecefe9cfd6e9873ad7fdfd5821507.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-108">\lambda&lt;/script>&lt;/span>各分量的值，再视&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-109-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="e169aa2d2b71835f2203bc943bda9a9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-109">x_i&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 自身就是从定义域&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-110-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="a6ada1f1e1210f3c668b119ce7243885.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-110">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span>到值域&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-111-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%;
