display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="b4832fb0501a084e034d1ede8255e820.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-111">R&lt;/script>&lt;/span>的函数，简记为&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-112-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="7c5188ba501f86e4c04a76d78d20fc53.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-112">f_i(x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n) = x_i, \quad i = 1, 2, \cdots, n.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
有&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-113-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8377f0cb29f98aea5e7b89594cfd7766.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-113">dx_i = df_i = \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_1}h_1 + \cdots + \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_i}h_i + \cdots + \frac{\partial x_i}{\partial x_n}h_n = h_i, \quad i = 1, 2, \cdots, n.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
这样就得到了全微分的具体写法&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-114-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="4c5a0d9944d2b8861cbd29b10fd065dc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-114">df = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_1}, \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_2}, \cdots, \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_n} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} dx_1 \\ dx_2 \\ \vdots \\ dx_n \end{bmatrix}.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
前面那个1* n向量同时对自变量各个分量的变化进行描述，不仅仅是单个分量的变化率，我们一般称它为梯度——&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>1.4 梯度&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-115-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="b0de535c94e93eb0a8bd178ded86240d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-115">n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 元函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-116-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2a940cb337e81e8e783cdb305da9cb4d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-116">f(x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-117-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2fab88a9546b31230752df140f2ac985.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-117">P&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处存在偏导数，则称向量&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-118-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c6fc302da5994f0e5e130745a7783f5e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-118">\nabla f = \left( \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_1}, \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_2}, \dots, \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_n} \right)&lt;/script>为函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-119-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="586065e450007655556cb0700824a30f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-119">f&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在点 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-120-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2fab88a9546b31230752df140f2ac985.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-120">P&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处的梯度。&lt;br>
&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;em>注意到梯度是一个向量而不是一个简单的映射到一个分量上的表达式，之后会有概念辨析&lt;/em>&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">有了梯度的工具，我们举个最简单、最有画面感的例子来熟悉一下上面的几条定义的作用：&lt;br>
设函数&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-121-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c5fe6e3d9f50023013557b2c3c599ecc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-121">f(x,y)&lt;/script>&lt;/span>是关于横向分量&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-122-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="91cb7973eb31bfc3b30a5bed6ffbc3e4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-122">x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>和纵向分量&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-123-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="47917c9aaacf04a9577a0c35c5f27a5e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-123">y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>的函数，表示山丘的高度&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-124-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="30ed2a15b6620d2dae60f0e55468f9bf.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-124">z&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，那么&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">全微分&lt;/strong>：假如你不仅向东走了一点（&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-125-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c27b28dd8ed4b1363ae73347bb801d60.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-125">dx&lt;/script>&lt;/span>），还向北走了一点（&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-126-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="bd8fcbf5e3f88a30eb865b2ab8eb6050.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-126">dy&lt;/script>&lt;/span>），也就是斜着迈出了一小步.&lt;br>
可得全微分&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-127-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="fd6ee6fff6f3901b9ff9dbb58068bafb.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-127">dz = f'_x dx + f'_y dy&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，它把东向和北向的贡献叠加起来，告诉你这一步迈出后，海拔总共变化了多少.本质上它是用一个切平面来近似你脚下的山坡，算出这个平面上的高度差.&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">偏微分&lt;/strong>：假如你向正东走了极短的距离 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-128-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c27b28dd8ed4b1363ae73347bb801d60.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-128">dx&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
可得偏微分&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-129-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="3cace1d40b00a903d93dc310917d31a7.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-129">d_x z = f'_x \cdot dx&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，它估算你这步走完后，海拔具体升高了多少米，本质上它是某个特定轴向上的“位移贡献”.&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">偏导数&lt;/strong>：假如你规定自己&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">只能&lt;/strong>沿正东（&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-130-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="91cb7973eb31bfc3b30a5bed6ffbc3e4.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-130">x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>轴）或正北（&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-131-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="47917c9aaacf04a9577a0c35c5f27a5e.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-131">y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>轴）走.&lt;br>
可得偏导数&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-132-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="f6e53f39e7fcf50a409eb6999a9dad7b.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-132">f'_x&lt;/script>&lt;/span>，它是你向正东迈出一小步，海拔高度的变化率.（&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-133-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5249b5c95a0da537c30a0597500e2c12.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-133">f'_y&lt;/script>&lt;/span>同理）本质上它是单一方向的“坡度”.&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">梯度&lt;/strong>：假如你随意走了一步，设你的步长恰好为1，记为&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-134-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8ac4c6dd40c1fc80fadcab025a94acfc.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-134">u&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
根据&lt;a href="#point1.3" class="xsj_link xsj_manu_link">上文&lt;/a>方向导数的知识并且带入全微分定义，&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-135-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="7fbcd928da80aa859b0d834ca7bbc0f2.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-135">\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}(x_0) := \lim_{t \to 0} \frac{f(x_0 + tu) - f(x_0)}{t}=\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\nabla f \cdot t u + o(t)}{t}=\nabla f \cdot \mathbf{u} = \|\nabla f\| \cdot \|\mathbf{u}\| \cdot \cos \theta=\|\nabla f\|  \cos \theta.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
可得梯度&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-136-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="0dcdcf259b226d77ff038aa2ecbba055.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-136">\nabla f &lt;/script>&lt;/span>就是上升最快的方向，这与我们的过往认知（导数就是上升最快的方向）一致.&lt;p>&lt;/p>
&lt;hr class="xsj_hr xsj_minus">
&lt;h2 class="xsj_heading_hash xsj_heading xsj_heading_h2" id="2_2">&lt;div class="xiaoshujiang_element xsj_anchor">
  &lt;a name="2_2" class="blank_anchor_name">&lt;/a>&lt;a id="2_2" class="blank_anchor_id">&lt;/a>&lt;a name="2" class="blank_anchor_name">&lt;/a>&lt;a id="2" class="blank_anchor_id">&lt;/a>

&lt;span class="xsj_heading_content">2&lt;/span>&lt;/h2>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">接下来我们拓展一下函数的种类.&lt;br>
注意到上文中的措辞：&lt;/p>
&lt;blockquote class="markdown_blockquote">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_1">&lt;span class="xsj_placeholder_span">&lt;/span>设函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-137-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="da7a451e421f6da5d3167fe45079901c.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-137">f : D \to \mathbb{R}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-138-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="a6ada1f1e1210f3c668b119ce7243885.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-138">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-139-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="729325af0857a514fa911712afa2d3a5.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-139">\mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 上的一个开集…&lt;/p>
&lt;/blockquote>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">可见这里的多元函数还是由&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">多&lt;/strong>化&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">一&lt;/strong>，那有没有从&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">多&lt;/strong>到&lt;strong class="markdown_strong_asterisk">多&lt;/strong>的呢？这就是向量值函数了.生活中常见的向量值函数有速度场、电场、天气预报模型、机器学习中的损失函数等.&lt;br>
下面直接给出向量值函数的可微定义&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>2.1 向量值函数的微分&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设向量值函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-140-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="42e6d71ea10b605e6ce7ca42e6dd963a.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-140">\mathbf{f} : D \to \mathbb{R}^m&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-141-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-141">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-142-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5314527605086d2c654c649fbd7ed01f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-142">\mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 中的一个开集. 给定 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-143-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8599c17c4fc196fc49421c15a932c441.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-143">x_0 \in D&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 若存在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-144-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="2eb7a25ce4adabf1c41bd3d4babcd7c1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-144">m \times n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 矩阵 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-145-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="25afd33dec5202b4b4792d92c5987596.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-145">\mathbf{A}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 使得&lt;/p>
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">&lt;/p>&lt;div class="mathjax-container" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;div class="mathjax">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;div class="MathJax_SVG_Display" style="text-align: center;">&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-146-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="4572b4ede6a948de82b9e1881ea69b67.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex; mode=display" id="MathJax-Element-146">\lim_{\|\mathbf{h}\| \to 0} \frac{\|\mathbf{f}(x_0 + \mathbf{h}) - \mathbf{f}(x_0) - \mathbf{A}\mathbf{h}\|}{\|\mathbf{h}\|} = 0.&lt;/script>&lt;br>
则称 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-147-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="1753113f293552ec3b36c89018d0fbf1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-147">\mathbf{f}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-148-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-148">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处可微, 称线性映射 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-149-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="67d05551d6af70556f0209793c5f3777.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-149">\mathbf{A}\mathbf{h}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-150-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="1753113f293552ec3b36c89018d0fbf1.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-150">\mathbf{f}&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-151-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="53449aa5f300e3c83f3a8ac220fdba9d.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-151">x_0&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 处的微分. 记作 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-152-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="05e674e945ca6d3eb4b39bcbe791af78.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-152">d\mathbf{f}(x_0) = \mathbf{A}\mathbf{h}&lt;/script>&lt;/span>.&lt;br>
&lt;p>&lt;/p>

&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">仔细观察比较&lt;a href="#point1.1" class="xsj_link xsj_manu_link">1.1&lt;/a>会发现变化：从&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-153-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="dafa732b29440954006de60e4f736068.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-153">f(x_0 + h) - f(x_0) - \lambda h&lt;/script>&lt;/span>变成了&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-154-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="d738af5cdacb59e33cc5030e502f0cc3.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-154">\|\mathbf{f}(x_0 + \mathbf{h}) - \mathbf{f}(x_0) - \mathbf{A}\mathbf{h}\|&lt;/script>&lt;/span>,这就是从一个数轴上的直接做减法变成了求高维空间中的范数，相应地，&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-155-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="0dcdcf259b226d77ff038aa2ecbba055.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-155">\nabla f&lt;/script>&lt;/span>也升级为&lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-156-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="94caee44b6f64eb355cf2f0a52eeb244.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-156">A&lt;/script>&lt;/span>,我们一般称其为Jacobi矩阵：&lt;/p>
&lt;div class="math-container" style="--head-bg: #4caf50; --head-font: 'Smiley Sans'; --content-font: 'Kaiti';">
    &lt;div class="math-header">
        &lt;span>2.2 Jacobi矩阵&lt;/span>
        &lt;span style="opacity: 0.8;">♣&lt;/span>
    
    &lt;div class="math-content">
&lt;p class="xsj_paragraph xsj_paragraph_level_0">设向量值函数 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-157-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="42e6d71ea10b605e6ce7ca42e6dd963a.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-157">\mathbf{f} : D \to \mathbb{R}^m&lt;/script>&lt;/span>, 其中 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-158-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="abf4513e86fb1abaa578d366ef874a48.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-158">D&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 是 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-159-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="5314527605086d2c654c649fbd7ed01f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-159">\mathbb{R}^n&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 中的一个开集. 给定 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-160-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="8599c17c4fc196fc49421c15a932c441.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-160">x_0 \in D&lt;/script>&lt;/span>. 若 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-161-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%; display: inline-block;">&lt;img class="svg-image" src="data:image/png;base64," name="c2e0a7d6b5e56472cf9e6c37cb3b431f.png" loading="lazy">&lt;/span>&lt;script type="math/tex" id="MathJax-Element-161">\mathbf{f} = (f_1, f_2, \cdots, f_m)&lt;/script>&lt;/span> 的所有分量函数在 &lt;span class="mathjax" data-vdom-skip="true" data-vdom-mathjax="true">&lt;span class="MathJax_Preview" style="color: inherit;">&lt;/span>&lt;span class="MathJax_SVG" id="MathJax-Element-162-Frame" role="math" style="font-size: 100%;
